dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Distinctive falcate curvature with a concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the posterior ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute-rounded classification with a small pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep positive gradient, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a large radius defining the anterior-dorsal boundary of the melon region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Thick, short proportional extension of the beak from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at approximately 135 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible posterior caudal fluke on the left lateral field and a single ventral-lateral pectoral fin.
